A refresh against main is in progress for this PR (main took #4249, which changed the same files). The current head will change, and the new head gets a comment with the merge details. A review of the new head is more useful than a review of the current head.

Refresh on the new #4233 head `d47c7e498` (it also holds `main` at `ef6e9ed97`). New head: `0d059d214`.

**Merge commits:** `2b928058a`, `5167bb0d9` and `0d059d214` (one merge for each parent push of this refresh).

**Conflict:** `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs`. The two sides added a module line and a doc line (`component_mcp` here, `multi_seat` from #4249). I kept the two sides.

**Hand edits in `2b928058a` (the #4249 fields that the parent now carries):**
- `mcp/component_library_tools.rs` and `component_mcp.rs`: the `DocumentComponent` literals use `DocumentComponent::new`.
- `mcp/component_tools.rs` `upsert_tool_component`: the call now lands the stated `milling` and `running` keys through `UpsertDocumentComponent::with_row`. Before, the tool parsed the keys and dropped them with no word. A key that the call does not state keeps the held value, and the library link stays (the same as a catalog-fact edit).
- `mcp/component_library_tools.rs` `save_library_component`: it goes through `LibraryComponent::from_row`, which refuses a row with cutter facts or running data by name. The follow-up for a library that holds them is #4295.
- New pinning test `component_mcp::mcp_upsert_carries_insert_running_data_and_a_library_save_refuses_it`.

**Class:** DELTA + NEW CODE (the upsert and save changes above).

**Gates (Mac):**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base d47c7e498`: 169 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (this includes `tool_library_holders` and the `mcp` suites).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The first line of the body names no parent head SHA, so the body has no change.

Ready for a re-check.

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-team2-4268-r2, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (team2 seat); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for merge at the next cut (a `feat`). Merge #4233 first, as the body says.** No blockers.

This is the first collaborator review of this PR. I reviewed head `0d059d214` trial-merged with upstream `main` `9b141e112`. The merge is clean (no conflict).

## Scope

- The PR holds the commits of #4233 (head `d47c7e498`, `merge-ready`). I read the delta of this PR over that head: 12 files, +872/-5. The #4233 part has its own review.
- The delta changes only the MCP surface (`crates/app/src/mcp/`), its tests, the `camcraft-mcp` skill and docs. It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a SAFETY-tier review. No golden or recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changes in the delta.
- No `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `Cargo.toml` or dependency change. No UI change, so no screenshots are necessary.

## What looks good

- Each document write runs the same undoable command as the GUI (`UpsertDocumentComponent::with_row`, `DeleteDocumentComponent`, `SetToolAssembly`, `SyncDocumentComponent`) through `env.history.execute`. The tests prove one undo step and redo.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in non-test code. Each refusal names the argument, the component or the tool.
- One wire form (`ComponentDto`, `deny_unknown_fields`) for the file, the library and MCP. A stated `library_ref` is refused, so only `sync_tool_component` writes a link.
- An unreadable library shows `unreadable` with the reason. It never shows `missing_from_library`.
- The two library write tools are `FileWrite` in the live gate. A stated `library` on the read tools is `FilePathAccess`.
- The tests use a temp `library` file. They do not write the real user library and do not set an environment variable.
- Each new file has a provenance line and is under 400 lines. The new tests join the `tool_library_holders` directory suite (no new test binary).
- Process: the body has `Process change: yes` (skill file changed) and does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3647`. A decision file is present.

## Results (local, macOS arm64, trial merge with main `9b141e112`)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_library_holders`: 36 passed, 0 failed. This includes the 4 pinning tests in `component_mcp`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp --test mcp_doc_drift --test mcp_live`: 56 + 9 + 29 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --test 'mcp_*'`: lib 319 passed; all 56 `mcp_*` suites passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (17.4 min).
- Mutations (not owed for this tier; I ran two):
  - `upsert_tool_component`: `running: row.running` (drop the held-value merge). `component_mcp::mcp_upsert_carries_insert_running_data_and_a_library_save_refuses_it` goes red at `component_mcp.rs:212`. Reverted: green.
  - `save_library_component`: skip the `builtin:` check. The tests stay green, because `component_library/store.rs:72` refuses the same id with the same text before a write. The MCP check is an early copy, so the mutation is equivalent. This is not a gap.
- The full quick plan against bare `main` is 416 steps, because the #4233 schema and project-file change maps to all app suites. I did not run all 416. The author reports `cargo xtask gate quick --base d47c7e498` on this head: 169 steps, 0 failed. My runs cover the binaries that the delta touches (the MCP table, the live gate, the docs drift and the pinning suite).
- Example catalog suites: not run. The delta changes no post and no toolpath.
- Heavy lanes: not run. The delta does not reach them, and they are not a review condition (#3556).

Extra suites run (test data / importers): none apply. The delta does not change `testdata/` or import code.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking (follow-ups, suggested P7)

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/live.rs:65` and `:73`: no test pins the new approval rows. `mcp_live` does not name the new tools. Add one assertion: `requires_approval("save_library_component", {})` and `delete_library_component` give `FileWrite`; `list_tool_components` with `library` gives `FilePathAccess`, and without it gives `None`. A later edit of the match arms can then not drop the write gate with no red test.
2. `crates/app/src/mcp/component_tools.rs` (`upsert_tool_component`, the `milling` / `running` merge): `row.milling.or(h.milling)` reads a stated `null` the same as an absent key. An agent cannot remove held running data or cutter facts through MCP. The tool description and the skill row say "a key the call does not state keeps the held value", so this is the documented behaviour. If removal is wanted, it needs an explicit form (for example a distinct `clear` list).
3. The body section "Gate results (head `dda741331`)" names the earlier head. The refresh comment of 2026-11-27 04:54 gives the results for `0d059d214`. No change is necessary; I note it for the merging session.

## Merge order

This PR stacks on #4233 (base is already `main`). Merge #4233 first. Then this PR takes `git merge origin/main`. The merging session classifies that refresh with `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 4268 --reviewed 0d059d214d8cd63415390e706bbc155a3991083c`. A SAME result keeps this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
